newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Hard-up Zimbabwe prostitutes hike charges.
newsitem.headline: Hard-up Zimbabwe prostitutes hike charges.

text.p: Hard-up prostitutes in Zimbabwe have raised their charges by 67 percent and told housewives to give their husbands more money to spend on their services.

"Housewives should sympathise with us and I am appealing to them to urge their husbands to bring more money when they go to beerhalls. We are not married but we also need to survive and send our children to school," a newspaper quoted a prostitutes' spokeswoman in the southern town of Masvingo as saying.

The provincial weekly Mirror quoted the group, which calls itself the Prostitutes Association of Zimbabwe, as saying men seeking its members' services would now pay Z$50 (U.S.$4.60) a night, up from Z$30 (U.S.$2.80).
Prostitution is illegal in the southern African country and police carry out periodic raids on people they suspect of soliciting.
